name: cc-jev-teacher
description: Claude Code hooks that make Claude finish the job: Jev (TypeSafe directly or through OpenRouter) judges each tool call and final report, and sends Claude back to work on script edits, unrequested config relaxation, building before searching, and unfinished, verbose or unmeasured reports. It also keeps context small by compacting without a summary and trimming long Bash output

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: API key for https://typesafe.ai. Leave empty when using OpenRouter

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: API key for https://openrouter.ai. When set, judgments go through OpenRouter instead of TypeSafe

openrouter_model.title: OpenRouter model
openrouter_model.description: Decision model on OpenRouter, such as respan/span-01-lite (default, free), respan/span-01 or typesafe/jev-1.13
